title: Developers Turned Claude Into a 24/7 Trading Desk
description:
Developers are wiring Claude up to run as an always-on market research and trading desk: a scheduled agent loop, a broker connection graded into one of three access tiers, and a hard-coded daily loss limit that halts it automatically.

This isn't one company's product — it's a pattern now showing up across Robinhood's new agentic-trading beta, Interactive Brokers' Claude integration, and dozens of independent builds using Claude Code's scheduled routines.

Sources: MindStudio "Build a 24/7 AI Trading Agent with Claude Code and Alpaca"; Finance Magnates — broker AI agent tiers and Interactive Brokers sign-off coverage; AnalyticsInsight — Claude Code trading-strategy guardrails (2026).
